mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP1A2 and CYP2D6, reducing duloxetine metabolism and increasing plasma concentrations; combined CNS depression and potential serotonergic effects with alcohol relapse risk.
action: Monitor for duloxetine toxicity (tremor, confusion, serotonin syndrome signs); consider duloxetine dose reduction; counsel on alcohol avoidance; ensure close psychiatric supervision.
